# SkillUp

> SkillUp is the Israeli marketplace for finding verified private tutors (מורים פרטיים) and booking private lessons (שיעורים פרטיים) anywhere in Israel — on the web at skillupwebsite.vercel.app and in the SkillUp iOS app. It connects students, parents, and adult learners directly with verified tutors, with no middlemen and no brokerage fees. Hebrew-first, full RTL.

## What you can do on the website

- Search and compare private tutors by subject, category, city, price, rating, and lesson mode — no signup needed to browse: https://skillupwebsite.vercel.app/search
- View full tutor profiles: real student reviews, experience, education, transparent prices per lesson mode, intro video, and live availability.
- Book a lesson directly from the tutor's real calendar (free account required). First lesson with a new tutor is confirmed by the tutor within 24 hours.
- Message tutors directly in a built-in chat (free account required).
- The same account works on the website and in the iOS app.

## Subject categories (each has a landing page under /categories/)

Mathematics & Sciences, Foreign Languages (incl. English), Hebrew & Language Arts, Exams & Test Prep (Bagrut/בגרות, Psychometric/פסיכומטרי, SAT), Humanities & Social Sciences, Sports & Fitness, Arts & Creativity, Programming & Technology, Leisure & Life Skills (cooking, driving, chess, and more).

## Cities

Tutor pages per city under /cities/ — including Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Haifa, Beer Sheva, Rishon LeZion, Petah Tikva, Netanya, Ramat Gan, Holon, Ashdod, Raanana, and Herzliya. Online lessons are available nationwide.

## Trust & privacy

- Verified tutors: identity, education credentials, and background approval before appearing in search.
- Reviews are written only by students who actually studied with the tutor through SkillUp.
- Personal contact details (phone, email, exact address) are never public; a tutor's address is revealed only after a lesson at their place is confirmed.
- Direct student–tutor connection with no brokerage fees.

## For tutors

- Join via the SkillUp iOS app: build a profile, set subjects, prices, and availability — the profile appears on the website and in the app.
- Real-time notifications for new inquiries and bookings; students nationwide can find you.
- Tutors can log in on the website to view messages and upcoming lessons.

## Key facts

- Geography: Israel (nationwide; online lessons everywhere).
- Language: Hebrew (full RTL). Many tutors also teach in English.
- Platforms: Web (this site) + iOS app. Android coming soon.
- Category: Education / Tutoring marketplace.

## בעברית

SkillUp היא המרקטפלייס הישראלי למציאת מורה פרטי מאומת ולקביעת שיעורים פרטיים — באתר ובאפליקציה. מחפשים לפי מקצוע, עיר, מחיר ודירוג, משווים פרופילים עם ביקורות אמיתיות של תלמידים, וקובעים שיעור ישירות מול המורה: אונליין, אצל המורה או אצלכם בבית. החיפוש פתוח לכולם בלי הרשמה; קביעת שיעור ושליחת הודעה דורשות חשבון חינמי, שמשותף לאתר ולאפליקציה. הקשר בין התלמיד למורה ישיר, בלי מתווכים ובלי עמלות. למורים: פרופיל שמופיע מול תלמידים בכל הארץ, יומן זמינות, צ'אט ישיר והתראות בזמן אמת.
